enhances.context: A measured Style Reference DESIGN.md (named tokens, type scale, components, Quick Start CSS/Tailwind) feeds sk-code implementation without hallucinating colors, fonts, spacing, or shadows

siblings.context: The reading half of a pair: this skill measures a surface that already exists, sk-design decides values for one that does not. A measured Style Reference outranks sk-design's defaults for the surface it covers
The mcp-figma / mcp-refero / mcp-mobbin design transports move design data; this skill produces the authoritative measured reference they pair with

derived.causal_summary: sk-design-md-generator is a standalone design skill that extracts a live website's real, measured CSS into a v3 Style Reference DESIGN.md through an embedded Playwright extract-write-validate pipeline (playwright-extract backend), so AI agents build against measured ground truth rather than hallucinated colors, fonts, spacing, or shadows. Graduated from the retired sk-design parent hub (which routed a separate interface direction mode that was deprecated; the sk-design name now belongs to the standalone authoring skill that is this skill's sibling), it also carries a condensed general design-knowledge layer distilled from the hub's shared reference base (anti-slop principles, cognitive and numeric design laws, design-token vocabulary, the Brand-versus-Product register, and structural-fingerprint pattern cards) so the surviving skill knows design, not only extraction. Its styles corpus and style database live under styles/ and are resolved self-relatively.
